MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB260703.10 (trigger No 804738310,21h 00m 43.92s , +48d 28m 01.2s, R=19.2) errorbox  4283 sec after notice time and 4323 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-03 03:37:09 UT, with upper limit up to  17.8 mag. Observations started at twilight.  The observations began at zenith distance = 69 deg. The sun  altitude  is -13.3 deg. 

The galactic latitude b =  1 deg., longitude l = 89 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3412721
